contract_answer.question: Does the ZN-E010 AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU configuration generalise to paper split 42 with a finite, healthy-gradient run so its metrics enter the 3-split confirmation aggregate for freezing as the Phase-1 model?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewed by CODEX(gemini-4-argon). Apply the proposal's per-run disposition exactly (VALID with gradient gate PASS -> KEEP as confirmation evidence). On paper split 42 (BL_SPLIT=42, seed 2021, Kaggle Tesla T4), ZN-E013 is a complete, finite 9-epoch confirmation run (414 optimizer steps, 46 steps/epoch, 106.326s training compute, 98,113 parameters, early stopping at epoch 9 after selecting the epoch-4 checkpoint where both minimum validation MAPE and highest Acc@15 within tolerance occur). Executed train.py equals the reviewed current train.py (T006 version), and the lead verified that the ZN-E010 configuration (fade_input='anchor' default) produces identical state_dict and outputs to the T004 code ZN-E010 ran with. From validation_predictions.npz and tools/rescore.py, ZN-E013 achieves MAPE 0.347109, Acc@15 0.2470, RMSE 350.290 cycles, MAE 183.728 cycles, DB-MAPE 0.347109, seen-condition MAPE 0.337404 (seen Acc@15 0.276923), unseen-condition MAPE 0.365132 (unseen Acc@15 0.191429), and prediction-target correlation 0.4928 (higher than both ZN-E010 on split 2021 [0.4785] and ZN-E006 on split 42 [0.4509]). Crucially, unlike ZN-E006 (the ZN-E005 bare-ReLU configuration on the same split 42, which achieved 0.338589 MAPE / 0.2475 Acc@15 / 347.720 RMSE but failed the gradient gate with inter_summary 0.5462 and head 0.5077 late near-zero gradients -> DISCARD), ZN-E013 passes the gradient gate cleanly: diagnostics.json reports overall_gradient_health HEALTHY with zero flags across all 6 blocks and late near-zero gradient fractions of 0.0000 in cycle_stem, 0.0365 in residual_blocks.0, 0.0583 in residual_blocks.1, 0.0206 in fade_encoder, 0.0000 in inter_summary, and 0.0000 in head. Padding invariance is exact (0.0), masks and activations are HEALTHY, and ZN-E013 is therefore KEEP as split-42 confirmation evidence, advancing to ZN-E014 on split 2024 before the 3-split aggregate decision.

main_symptom: On split 42, ZN-E013 (AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU) resolves the readout dead-gradient failure that caused ZN-E006 (ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0 on split 42) to be DISCARD, driving inter_summary and head late near-zero gradient fractions from 0.5462 / 0.5077 down to 0.0000 / 0.0000 (overall_gradient_health HEALTHY, no flags) while matching ZN-E006 on Acc@15 (0.2470 vs 0.2475), unseen-condition MAPE (0.3651 vs 0.3663), and RMSE (350.29 vs 347.72 cycles; headline MAPE 0.3471 vs 0.3386, seen MAPE 0.3374 vs 0.3237) and improving prediction-target correlation to 0.4928 (vs 0.4509 in ZN-E006 and 0.4785 in ZN-E010). Across splits 2021 -> 42, Acc@15 drops from 0.3665 to 0.2470 and prediction SD compresses to 67.12 cycles vs target SD 336.44 cycles (ratio 0.1995), with severe Relative-Huber tail underprediction on the 3 validation cells with EOL >= 500 cycles: the 17 short-life cells (<500 cycles) achieve MAPE 0.2748, Acc@15 0.2906, and bias -47.13 cycles (6.41% of total squared error), whereas the single 500-1000-cycle cell (ZN-coin_434-1, EOL 837) has MAPE 0.7202, Acc@15 0.0, and bias -602.77 cycles (14.87% of total squared error) and the two >1000-cycle cells (ZN-coin_434-2 [EOL 1010] and ZN-coin_436-1 [EOL 1402]) have MAPE 0.7753, Acc@15 0.0, and bias -949.14 cycles (78.72% of total squared error; combined >=500-cycle cells contribute 93.59% of total squared error).

contradicting_evidence: Although ZN-E013 passes the gradient gate and improves prediction-target correlation on split 42 (0.4928 at epoch 4, rising to 0.6360 at epoch 9, vs 0.4509 in ZN-E006), its epoch-4 selected-checkpoint MAPE is +0.0085 higher than ZN-E006 (0.3471 vs 0.3386) and includes 4 transient negative predictions (-62.16 to -36.00 cycles on ZN-coin_436-1 at prefixes 34-37, which disappear in epochs 5-9).
causes.interpretation: On split 42, the previous confirmation candidate ZN-E006 (ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0 with bare ReLU) failed the gradient gate because more than half of the inter_summary (0.5462) and head (0.5077) parameters had near-zero gradients at step 185. ZN-E013 confirms that the ZN-E010 architecture (AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU) completely eliminates dead readout gradients on split 42: at step 185, near-zero gradient fractions are 0.0000 in cycle_stem, 0.0000 in inter_summary, 0.0000 in head, 0.0206 in fade_encoder, 0.0365 in residual_blocks.0, and 0.0583 in residual_blocks.1, with active_feature_fraction_min 1.0 in every block and healthy branch gradient balance (77.58x < 1000x). This satisfies the pre-registered per-run confirmation gate (KEEP).
missing_evidence: Confirming that the same healthy gradient profile and paper-beating aggregate metrics hold on paper split 2024 (ZN-E014).

contradicting_evidence: Prefix progression remains strongly informative on split 42: validation MAPE improves monotonically from 0.4193 at prefixes 01-10 (Acc@15 0.100, RMSE 395.97) to 0.3876 at 26-50 (Acc@15 0.184, RMSE 360.08), 0.3129 at 51-75 (Acc@15 0.310, RMSE 325.74), and 0.2703 at 76-100 (Acc@15 0.382, RMSE 320.51).

Across the two completed splits (2021 and 42), the running 2-split mean is MAPE 0.3398 (well below the paper CPTransformer 3-split benchmark 0.515) and Acc@15 0.3068 (above the paper CPMLP benchmark 0.297).
causes.interpretation: Both ZN-E013 and ZN-E006 exhibit the exact same split-42 error structure across EOL bands and seen/unseen regimes: on the 17 short-life validation cells (<500 cycles), ZN-E013 achieves MAPE 0.2748 and Acc@15 0.2906 (vs 0.2678 and 0.2912 in ZN-E006), while unseen-condition MAPE is 0.3651 vs seen-condition 0.3374 (a 0.0277 gap, narrower than ZN-E006's 0.0426 gap [0.3663 vs 0.3237]). Meanwhile, under locked Phase-1 Relative Huber loss (delta = 0.15, whose linear-regime gradient scales as 1/y), the model compresses predictions below 374.5 cycles at epoch 4 (and 490.0 cycles at epoch 9), resulting in -602.77 cycles of bias on the single 500-1000 cell (ZN-coin_434-1, EOL 837) and -949.14 cycles of bias on the two >1000 cells (ZN-coin_434-2 [EOL 1010] and ZN-coin_436-1 [EOL 1402]), which together account for 93.59% of total squared error (93.88% in ZN-E006). Addressing this 1/y tail compression is the primary objective of Phase-2 loss rebalancing once the 3-split confirmation completes.
missing_evidence: Split-2024 confirmation metrics (ZN-E014) to finalize the 3-split mean +/- std before unlocking Phase-2 tail-balanced and physics-informed loss experiments.

contradicting_evidence: Training loss decreases smoothly from 0.05749 at epoch 1 to 0.03565 at epoch 9 (first_to_last_train_loss_ratio 0.6201), and validation RMSE and correlation continue improving through epochs 8-9 (RMSE 350.29 at epoch 4 -> 344.90 at epoch 8 -> 338.06 at epoch 9; correlation 0.4928 -> 0.5724 -> 0.6360 with 0 extreme predictions).
causes.interpretation: On the 20-cell split-42 validation set, validation MAPE reaches its minimum early at epoch 4 (0.3471, Acc@15 0.2470, RMSE 350.29) and then fluctuates between 0.3666 and 0.4045 over epochs 5-9 as later epochs push maximum predictions higher (from 374.5 cycles at epoch 4 to 490.0 cycles at epoch 9, cutting RMSE to 338.06 and raising correlation to 0.6360 at the cost of slight upward bias on short-life cells). Early stopping at epoch 9 (patience 5 after epoch 4, with minimum_epochs 5 satisfied) and checkpoint selection at epoch 4 functioned exactly per protocol.
missing_evidence: Evaluating split 2024 (ZN-E014) to observe checkpoint selection stability and complete the 3-split confirmation table.
